note: Official MoEYS result lists published on the ministry’s website and Facebook (1 May 2016), as archived in Seuksa’s 2016 post. Read from enlarged copies of the archived images; many names are confirmed by the same students appearing in the 2013 and 2019 lists. Battambang led the provinces this year.
